model.name.note: The standalone loop accepts a configured provider and model name. The engine does not resolve or observe the model.

model.effort.note: Argentic sends the effort value to Chat Completions and OpenAI Responses. Anthropic Messages maps supported efforts to native thinking settings and enables manual thinking when the output limit allows its minimum budget. When effort fallback is enabled, an effort rejection triggers a retry with the effort configuration omitted for the rest of the work attempt.

reviewer.person.note: The embedding host supplies the human approval port. An ask fails closed when the port is absent.

instance.new.note: The standalone loop starts fresh. AgSDL work and instance lifecycle integration is pending.

read.note: The harness implements local read decisions, but enforcement for AgSDL work is pending.

shell.note: Shell rules match the command text, including each subcommand of a compound command, but not programs that a matched command starts. Dynamic command words and shell constructs that indirectly execute commands take the most restrictive explicit shell rule. Shell requires system Bubblewrap and working PID and user namespaces on Linux ARM64 or x86-64, or Seatbelt on macOS ARM64.

network.note: The OS blocks direct shell egress. HTTP and HTTPS clients use the local Argentic proxy, which applies every effective host rule and requires a person for ask. Clients that ignore the proxy environment have no network access. Private addresses require an explicit IP rule.

forceSubmissionOnCorrection.description: Force the result tool by name after a missing required submission. Defaults to true. If the provider rejects the named choice, Argentic retries with required (any for Anthropic Messages) and only the result tool. If the provider rejects that form, Argentic disables forced choice for the rest of the attempt and restores all tools. Argentic uses automatic tool selection on requests that deliver steering and on Anthropic Messages requests with manual extended thinking.

compaction.description: Summarize older conversation turns before reaching the configured provider context window.

enabled.description: Defaults to true when the provider context window is configured.

threshold.description: Fraction of the window, strictly between zero and one. Defaults to 0.8.

keepRecentTurns.description: Positive count of recent assistant turns to retain verbatim. Defaults to four.
